steps.code:
# Create notes for remaining files, skipping existing titles
existing_titles = {note['title'] for note in existing_notes}
created_count = 0
skipped_count = 0
failed_count = 0

for file_path in files:
    # Extract filename without extension and directory
    filename = file_path.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]
    if filename.endswith('.md'):
        base = filename[:-3]
    else:
        base = filename
    title = base.replace('_', ' ')
    
    if title in existing_titles:
        print(f"Skipping (already exists): {title}")
        skipped_count += 1
        continue
    
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Create note
    try:
        result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
        print(f"Created note: {title} (id: {result.get('note_id')})")
        created_count += 1
        existing_titles.add(title)  # avoid duplicates in case of retry
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Failed to create note for {title}: {e}")
        failed_count += 1

print(f"\nSummary: created={created_count}, skipped={skipped_count}, failed={failed_count}")
